title: A torus-collar proof of the real-spectrum compact-support classification for Nijenhuis operators
strongest_verified_result: For every n>=1 and every numerical real Jordan matrix with entirely real spectrum, there exists a globally C-infinity compactly supported real Nijenhuis operator on R^n whose matrix equals the prescribed matrix in a commuting smooth local frame on a nonempty open domain. Conversely, every eigenvalue at every point of every compactly supported smooth real Nijenhuis operator on R^n is real.
scope_limits: The frame is a commuting local frame, not a prescribed ambient Cartesian frame.
Type, rank and eigenvalues may change outside the realization domain; no global regularity or single global Jordan type.
Smooth construction, not nonzero real-analytic compact support.
Zero matrix, zero/repeated eigenvalues, arbitrary block sizes and dimension1 are included.
No full-result or construction-method priority claim, and no certification that the question remained globally open before this note.
